images.title: Peak months differ by coast
images.purpose: Shows that Udupi on the west coast peaks in June to August while Rameswaram on the east coast peaks in October to December, and both are dry in January to March.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Two rows of 12 month cells, one above the other, aligned month by month.
images.exact_structure: Two horizontal rows of 12 equal square cells, one row above the other and aligned, one cell per month from January on the left to December on the right. Top row, labelled Udupi at its left: cells 6, 7 and 8 (June, July, August) filled teal (#0072B2); the other 9 cells white. Bottom row, labelled Rameswaram at its left: cells 10, 11 and 12 (October, November, December) filled amber (#E69F00); the other 9 cells white. Cells 1 to 3 of both rows have a light grey (#6B7280) hatch, with the word dry under the bottom row below them. Under the bottom row only four month names appear, Jan under cell 1, Jun under cell 6, Oct under cell 10 and Dec under cell 12. The word peak sits above the teal block.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Cities on different coasts get their peak rain in different months.
images.description: Shows that Udupi on the west coast peaks in June to August while Rameswaram on the east coast peaks in October to December, and both are dry in January to March.
images.context: Peak months from the rainfall graphs: Udupi June to August, Rameswaram October to December; January to March dry for all six cities.

image_decisions.why: Two aligned month rows show the core comparison the practice tool asks for, without the busy graph.
